newsitem.title: GREECE: Greece probes reports of Christmas ship collision.
newsitem.headline: Greece probes reports of Christmas ship collision.

text.p: Greece was on Saturday investigating testimony by detained illegal immigrants who said scores of people drowned on Christmas Day when ships collided in the Malta-Sicily channel.

The marine ministry said in a statement that 107 Indian and Pakistani immigrants had been arrested near the southern port Nafplion and told police they experienced the collision in which hundreds of their compatriots were lost at sea.

The ministry said that according to the testimony, the cargo ship Yoham, flying a Honduras flag, struck a smaller ship after 320 of the immigrants had transferred from the Yoham to the smaller vessel.
"According to the immigrants' testimonies the smaller ship sank and only about 30 people were rescued," the statement said.
Police said the Yoham managed to rescue only 29 people from from the sinking ship and then continued its voyage to Greece.
"All the information has been onpassed to the Rome search and rescue centres which have not confirmed them until today," the ministry statement said.
